eat.speaker: Henri
lines: Eat. You will think better with food in you.

thin.speaker: Marguerite
lines: He is too thin for a soldier. They are sending boys now.

how_many.speaker: Henri
lines: Your aeroplane. How many came out of it?

choices.text: I counted four chutes. Maybe more.
I don't know. It was dark, and it was fast.
Why do you need to know that?

counted.speaker: Henri
lines: Four. Then there are three others walking tonight, or worse. The country will be full of eyes by morning.

counted_vague.speaker: Henri
lines: No one ever knows. That is the trouble with the sky — it does not keep records.

why_ask.speaker: Henri
lines: Because the Germans will know. They count everything. If four men fell and they find three, they keep looking.

pat.speaker: Travis
lines: There was another chute, short of the treeline. My friend was on the waist gun. If he came down anywhere near—

pat_answer.speaker: Henri
lines: If he is alive, the country will find him before you do. Eat.

seen.speaker: Henri
lines: Your parachute was seen from the road. Men came asking before sunset — not soldiers. Worse. The ones who write things down.

not_seen.speaker: Henri
lines: The wind carried you well. No one saw you come down but Luc, and Luc does not talk. Do you, Luc.

luc.speaker: Luc
lines: Is it true the bombers fly higher than birds can breathe?

choices.text: Higher. You wear a mask, or you go to sleep and you don't wake up.

luc_wonder.speaker: Luc
lines: Higher than birds. And you jumped from there.

enough.speaker: Marguerite
lines: Enough, Luc. — You. Sleep. Tomorrow Henri decides what is to be done with you.

luck.speaker: Henri
lines: You were lucky with the field, American. Luck is not a plan.
